pages.lesson:
LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: SPELLING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Writing 3.1 Guided Writing: Handwriting (2 sessions) • Neatness and legibility •
Topic 3.2: Guided Writing: Spelling

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Writing: Spelling. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can you ensure the correct spelling of words when writing?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use acquired vocabulary to make sentences neatly and legibly
2. appreciate neat and legible handwriting for effective communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GUIDED WRITING: SPELLING
This lesson teaches Guided Writing: Spelling for Grade 7 ARABIC.

STUDY STEPS
1. use acquired vocabulary to make sentences neatly and legibly
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate neat and legible handwriting for effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Guided Writing: Spelling using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Guided Writing: Spelling above.
2. Explain Guided Writing: Spelling to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Guided Writing: Spelling.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided Writing: Spelling with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Guided Writing: Spelling important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you ensure the correct spelling of words when writing?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. use acquired vocabulary to make sentences neatly and legibly
2. appreciate neat and legible handwriting for effective communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
